title: Shardana Sailing Charters

services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Set sail on a half-day sailing trip aboard S/V Shardana - a private, relaxed 3-hour sailing experience on the beautiful Chesapeake Bay. Whether you’re a first-time sailor or a seasoned cruiser, this trip offers the perfect balance of gentle breezes, scenic views, and time on the water. You’re welcome to bring your own snacks and drinks (remember to avoid glass) - and if you’d like to bring wine or beer, BYOB is permitted within safety regulations. Departure and Sailing Aboard Board at your scheduled time and set off from Rock Hall, MD. In just minutes, you’ll be under sail and heading out into the bay.
